en.headline: Election Committee receives 29 more nomination forms on day nine
en.dek: Returning officers took in 26 candidate forms and three from designated bodies on Thursday, lifting the cumulative totals to 1,112 and 38 respectively ahead of the October 20 close.
body: The Returning Officers for the various subsectors of the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections received a total of 26 nomination forms for candidates and three nomination forms from designated bodies on Thursday, according to a government statement.

This brings the cumulative totals since nominations opened on October 7 to 1,112 candidate forms and 38 forms from designated bodies. The nomination period ends on October 20, with the elections scheduled for November 22.

Among the forms received on Thursday, notable numbers came from the architectural, surveying, planning and landscape subsector (12), social welfare (8), and real estate and construction (2), the statement listed.

Officials have previously noted that the Candidate Eligibility Review Committee may request supplementary information from nominees, with a deadline of 5pm on October 20 for such forms to facilitate processing.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉提名期第九日再接獲29份提名表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任今日接獲26份候選人提名表格及3份指定團體提名表格，累計分別達1112份及38份，提名期將於10月20日結束。
body: 政府新聞處表示，2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉各有關界別分組的選舉主任，今日共接獲26份候選人提名表格及3份指定團體提名表格。
自10月7日提名期開始至今，累計已接獲1112份候選人提名表格及38份指定團體提名表格。提名期將於10月20日結束，選舉投票定於11月22日舉行。
根據公布，今日接獲的提名中，建築、測量、都市規劃及園境界有12份，社會福利界有8份，地產及建造界有2份。
當局早前已指出，候選人資格審查委員會或要求獲提名人提交補充資料，相關表格須於10月20日下午5時前遞交，以便處理。
